DANMIN JIKKEN - macOS (arm64 = Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4, amd64 = Intel)

1. Unzip, then in Terminal in that folder:
       chmod +x danmin
       ./danmin
2. The build is NOT signed or notarized (it is a student project), so macOS
   will say it cannot verify the developer. Either:
     - right-click the file "danmin" in Finder, choose Open, then Open again; or
     - remove the quarantine flag once:
           xattr -d com.apple.quarantine danmin
   If the system still blocks it: System Settings > Privacy & Security >
   "Open Anyway".

Saves: scores (danmin_scores.txt) and settings (danmin_settings.json) are
written NEXT TO the executable. Keep the game in a folder you can write to
(not inside a read-only disk image).

Keys: F11 or Cmd+F fullscreen, F10 CRT filter, Esc skips the prologue and hints.
Settings are in the title menu.

CONTENT WARNING: suicide, self-harm, death, graphic gore, and strong flashing
lights (a strobe). Settings has a "Reduce flashing" option.

Credits: SOUND-CREDITS.txt. Licence: LICENSE (code) and LICENSE-ART.md (art).
